This workspace contains a FastAPI backend and a React (Material-UI) frontend for a GitLab Project Manager UI. Backend endpoints should call the analytics/reporting logic. Frontend should use tabs, parameter forms, and display results from the backend API. All code should be modular, clean, and modern.

Always set the GITLAB_TOKEN environment variable before running the backend (see README for details).
